title: Lone impeachment article shuts door on 'dilatory tactics' — Luistro
summary: The prosecution’s decision to drop three impeachment articles against Vice President Sara Duterte is to prevent “further dilatory tactics,", lead House prosecutor Gerville Luistro said Wednesday.
